title: Runway Salt Layers and Pricing Sensitivity Playbook
content:
Purpose and scope:
This working sheet captures a layered runway buffer ("salt layers") approach, an HC trigger matrix, and a compact pricing-sensitivity analysis for Q2–Q4 2026. It is a pragmatic playbook for near-term actions that finance + GTM + Eng may execute when token demand or pricing environment changes.

Executive summary (2 lines):
- Maintain 18–24 weeks of operational runway under the Holdline scenario while preserving a 10–12% capacity cushion for peak bursts.
- Pricing moves are modeled against three elasticity regimes; recommended initial public-facing price adjustments limited to +5% (test cohort) with pre-wired HC triggers.

Key assumptions (explicit):
- Base monthly spend (hosted infra + people + opex): $6.8M (May 2026 baseline).
- Average monthly token volume: 45B tokens. Token-mix shifts: embeddings 12%, chat gen 65%, rerank/ops 23%.
- Short-term price elasticity benchmarks: low-elasticity groups (enterprise embeddings) e = -0.2; mid (chat gen) e = -0.7; high (freemium low-commit) e = -1.5.
- Hiring lead times: IC hires 6–10 weeks; senior hires 12–20 weeks.

Salt-layer runway model (explain):
- Salt layer = discrete buffer buckets to protect runway and feature delivery cadence. Layers (top->bottom):
  1) Burst reserve (2 weeks): covers demand spikes or multi-region failover cost; funded by short-term spot to reserved switch.
  2) Growth cushion (6 weeks): funds continued hiring and experiments for product-led scaling.
  3) Defensive buffer (10 weeks): runway until reduced-scope ops if revenue declines.
  4) Strategic reserve (rolling 4 weeks held as dry powder for opportunistic M&A or tooling purchases).
- Target combined salt layers = 22 weeks (configurable by scenario).

HC trigger matrix (condensed):
CSV-style table:
Trigger,Metric threshold,Immediate action,Follow-up decision window
T1: Slowdown-alert,MoM revenue decline >= 6%,Pause non-critical hiring; freeze external vendor spend,2 weeks review
T2: Holdline,2-month rolling ARR usage drop 10%,Implement hiring slowdown and 15% discretionary budget hold,4 weeks reprioritize roadmap
T3: Constrained,3-month ARR decline >= 20% or cash burn exceeds plan by 25%,Initiate selective layoffs and runway-conserving rollback,8 weeks exec review + board notice
T4: Surge,MoM token volume +30% with <5% increase in cost-to-serve,Temporarily activate burst reserve and accelerate short-term hiring for ops,2 weeks capacity audit

Pricing sensitivity experiments (summary):
- Design: 3x price change bands by customer cohort: -10%, 0%, +5% (pilot), +10% (internal shadow). Each cohort (enterprise, mid-market, freemium) has expected CVR changes based on elasticity.
- Modeling outputs (example):
Cohort,Elasticity,Projected revenue delta (pilot +5%),Projected token demand delta
Enterprise,-0.2,+3.8%, -1.0%
Mid-market,-0.7,+2.9%, -3.5%
Freemium,-1.5,+0.0% (net churn risk), -7.5%
Notes: pilot +5% lifts per-unit revenue but will suppress freemium volume nonlinearly; net platform revenue depends on mix.

Micro-scenarios (blue-sky / holdline / constrained):
- Blue-sky: accelerated adoption, token growth +40% Y/Y, maintain salt layers but pull 3 weeks from strategic reserve to finance immediate infra scaling. HC plan: hire 1x infra team (4 IC) and 2x solutions engineers Q3.
- Holdline (base-case): token flat, target 22-week salt layers, slow hires to replace attrition only, delay non-essential experiments.
- Constrained: token down 25% Y/Y, trigger T3, convert 40% of burst reserve to payroll runway, defer product launches >Q3.

Month,NetRev($M),GrossBurn($M),NetBurn($M),Headcount,TokenVolume(B)

Notes: net burn values intentionally left for scenario calc sheet (this doc focuses on triggers & playbook).

Recommended immediate actions (next 30 days):
- Lock a +5% pilot price for 10% of mid-market customers (randomized cohort). Track cohort-specific conversion and token demand daily. Owner: Lina.
- Implement automated HC trigger alerts in payroll ledger + People dashboard (JIRA FIN-1291). Owner: Marco.
- Define reverse-fallback plan for autoprice (ability to revert cohort in <72 hours). Owner: Product operations + Finance.

Open questions & hypotheses to validate:
- Hypothesis A: Mid-market elasticity is closer to -0.45 in practice due to new PLG features — validate via A/B in two geographic buckets.
- Hypothesis B: Embedding customers are price-inelastic for small percentage changes if we segment by committed volume — requires contract-level analysis.
- Data gap: per-route token cost attribution granularity is currently noisy; need SRE/infra runbook to attribute 90% of tokens to route by end of Q3.

Playbook for communications:
- If T1 triggered: ops email + slack channel to execs w/ morning snapshot. Finance to prepare 3-slide update for GTM.
- If T2/T3 triggered: board-readiness packet drafted within 7 days. Staffing communications playbook to align with People Ops.
